title: Session State remains after the tab is closed

labels.name: status:confirmed
labels.description: Bug has been confirmed by the Streamlit team

labels.name: priority:P2
labels.description: Medium-high priority - fix within one month

body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When closing a browser tab the session state does not get wiped immediately. Expected behaviour should be that the browser close gets detected instantaneous. This makes pages with a while loop not break out of them quick enough.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import streamlit as st
import time
from datetime import datetime

def get_datetime():
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

if 'last_update' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.last_update = get_datetime()

text = st.empty()

while "last_update" in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.last_update = get_datetime()
    text.write(f"last_update: {st.session_state.last_update}")
    time.sleep(1)

print("Exit because browser closed...")
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Run the code
2. Open browser
3. Check for output, close the browser
4. Streamlit app will now take a very long time before actually printing the exit message...

### Expected Behavior

Expected behaviour would be to detect the closing of the browser quicker. Doesn't need to be instant, but it should be quicker in my opinion. Or maybe even configurable.


In the [docs ](https://docs.streamlit.io/library/advanced-features/session-state#caveats-and-limitations)it states the following:

> Caveats and limitations
> Here are some limitations to keep in mind when using Session State:
> 
> - Session State exists for as long as the tab is open and connected to the Streamlit server. As soon as you close the tab, everything stored in Session State is lost.

This information suggests that closign the tab / browser the session state is lost, but that is not the case.

### Current Behavior

After closing the browser tab, it will take a long time before it gets detected by Streamlit. 

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.18.1
- Python version: 3.10.9
- Operating System: Windows 11 (WSL2)
- Browser: Chrome
- Virtual environment: conda


### Additional Information

I spent some time on this, but I have no idea how to fix this. It can sometimes take up to 25 new browser tabs before a lot of sessons get closed at once.

### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I am willing to submit a PR!
